initialize_rig_button.tip: Start a rig from the latest publish.
initialize_rig_button.what: Finds the asset picked above in the show and sets up a rig scene from its latest model publish.
examples: Pick show and asset, click __init__ to start rigging it.
Start rigging a new asset from its approved model.
initialize_rig_button.details: star Project.findby_name(show), finds the asset and its latest publish, and sets up the rig scene from it. Studio pipeline only.

shampooBtn.what: Opens the asset checks tool to find and fix scene problems before publishing.
examples: Run it before every publish.
Run checks after a rebuild.

unlock_geo.what: Sets the Global ctrl Geo display to normal so you can select the meshes.
examples: Unlock to pick a mesh and paint weights.
Unlock to select a mesh for the skin tools.
unlock_geo.details: Global_Ctrl.Geo = 0 (normal) and overrideEnabled 0 on everything under "geo".

lock_geo.what: Sets the Global ctrl Geo display to reference so clicks go to the ctrls, not the meshes.
examples: Lock it before giving the rig to animators.
Lock before a playblast so clicks hit ctrls.
lock_geo.details: Global_Ctrl.Geo = 2 (reference display) and overrideEnabled 0 under "geo" so the Global ctrl override wins.

wip.tip: Switch the rig to WIP mode.
wip.what: Shows rig, bind and ctrls, unlocks the geo and takes Mutant_Build out so you can keep rigging.
examples: Open a published rig, click Wip to work on it again.
Wip before a rebuild.
wip.details: Shows rig / bind / control, unlocks the geo, unparents Mutant_Build and Mutant_Tools_Grp to the world so the AutoRigger finds them.

complete.tip: Switch the rig to Complete mode.
complete.what: Puts Mutant_Build and the rig groups in their final places, ready to publish.
examples: Click it right before publishing.
Complete before publishing.
complete.details: Mutant_Build under Template_Grp, Mutant_Tools_Grp under rig, Ctrl_Grp under control, Rig / Bind groups into the studio hierarchy.

zeroX.tip: Put the selected guides at X 0.
zeroX.what: Moves the selected guides to the center line (X = 0), keeping Y and Z.
examples: Center the spine guides that drifted off the middle.
Center the jaw and nose guides.
zeroX.details: Moves each selected guide to world X 0 keeping Y / Z. Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

zeroY.tip: Put the selected guides at Y 0.
zeroY.what: Moves the selected guides to the ground (Y = 0), keeping X and Z.
examples: Put the heel guides on the floor.
Put foot heels on the ground.
zeroY.details: Moves each selected guide to world Y 0 keeping X / Z. Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

zeroZ.tip: Put the selected guides at Z 0.
zeroZ.what: Moves the selected guides to Z = 0, keeping X and Y.
examples: Line up the arm guides on one plane.
Align the clavicles in depth.
zeroZ.details: Moves each selected guide to world Z 0 keeping X / Y. Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

line_up_finger.what: Gives every selected guide the same Z as the first one, so the finger is straight.
steps: Select the finger guides, base first.
examples: Select the index guides, base first, click it.
Straighten every finger chain.
line_up_finger.details: Sets translateZ of every selected guide to the first one. Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

unparent_guides.what: Takes the guides out of their hierarchy so you can move each one alone.
examples: Unparent, move a single guide, then Parent.
Unparent to move the wrist without moving the fingers.
unparent_guides.details: Stores block order and hierarchy, then unparents every guide under the *_Block nodes (PhonemesUI_Block is skipped).

parent_guides.what: Puts the guides back in their hierarchy and block order.
examples: Click it after Unparent and your fixes.
Parent back before building.
parent_guides.details: Skeletor.parent_hierarchy(stored hierarchy) + reorder_block_guides(stored order). Needs an Unparent from this same session.

ankle_to_ankle.tip: Snap the foot ankle to the leg ankle.
ankle_to_ankle.what: Moves the foot block ankle guide onto the leg ankle guide.
examples: Click it when the foot floats away from the leg.
Snap after resizing legs.
ankle_to_ankle.details: Point snaps L_Foot_Ankle_Guide onto L_Ankle_Guide (left side only, the build mirrors). Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

wrist_to_writs.tip: Snap the hand to the wrist.
wrist_to_writs.what: Moves the hand palm guide onto the arm wrist guide.
examples: Click it when the hand is detached from the arm.
Snap after scaling the arm.
wrist_to_writs.details: Point snaps L_Hand_Palm_Guide onto L_Wrist_Guide (left side only). Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

neck_to_spine.tip: Snap the neck to the spine end.
neck_to_spine.what: Moves the neck guide onto the end of the spine.
examples: Click it when there is a gap between spine and neck.
Snap after resizing the spine.
neck_to_spine.details: Point snaps Neck_Guide onto Spine_End_Guide. Guides are unparented first and parented back after (block order kept), so children do not move with the guide.

fix_arms.what: Re-aims the arm guides so the joints come out with clean orients.
examples: Click it after auto placing the guides, before building.
Run every Fix button in order (COG, pelvis, spine, legs, foot, clavicle, arms, head) after Auto Place Guides.
Run fix arms again after moving its guides by hand.
fix_arms.details: wrap_utils.Wrap3D().fix_*_orientation(): re-aims the guides of that part from their own positions (no positions change). Runs on the L side; the build mirrors it.

fix_fingers_t.tip: Fix the finger orients for a T pose.
fix_fingers_t.what: Re-aims every finger guide for a character in T pose.
examples: Use it on a model with flat, straight arms.
Fix finger orients after auto placing a T pose.

fix_fingers_a.tip: Fix the finger orients for an A pose.

Reset before Normalize Fingers when the thumb reset came out bent.
thumb_reset.details: wrap_utils.zero_specific_finger(<finger>): zeroes the rotations of that finger guides.

normalize_fingers_btn.what: Spaces the finger guides evenly along each finger.
examples: Click it when the knuckles are bunched up.
Even out fingers after moving knuckles.
normalize_fingers_btn.details: wrap_utils.normalize_fingers(): evens the spacing of each finger guide chain.

shoe_to_guides.tip: Fit the foot guides to the selected shoe.
shoe_to_guides.what: Select the shoe geo: places the toe, heel and side guides on its bounding box.
steps: Check the toe, heel and side pivots.
examples: Select the left shoe and click it.
Fit foot guides to boots.
shoe_to_guides.details: Duplicates the shoe, makes its bounding box (geomToBBox) and snaps the foot guides to its edges with clusters, then deletes the helpers.

place_push_loc_btn.what: Creates the push joint locators around knees, hips, elbows and shoulders, sized with the slider.
examples: Click it, move the locators where the skin should push out.
Place push locators on a new character.
place_push_loc_btn.details: Creates L_Push_*_loc locators (knee front / back, hip front / back / out, elbow, shoulder...) parented to their guides, in L_PushJointCreationLocators_Grp.

mirror_push_joints_grp_btn.what: Mirrors the left push locators group to the right side.
examples: Place the left side only, click it.
Mirror the locators after placing the left side.
mirror_push_joints_grp_btn.details: Mirrors the selected group (or L_PushJointCreationLocators_Grp) to its R_ name.

remove_duplicate_names.what: Renames nodes that share a name so every node name is unique.
examples: Click it when a check says names are not unique.
Fix names before publishing.
remove_duplicate_names.details: Studio asset check CheckUniqueNames on the SID, then renames each clash with a random number.

studio_tag_ctrls.tip: Tag the ctrls for the studio pipeline.
studio_tag_ctrls.what: Tags every *_Ctrl as an animation controller for the pipeline.
examples: Click it before publishing so the anim tools find the ctrls.
Tag ctrls so the pipeline anim tools find them.
studio_tag_ctrls.details: rigSystem: tags every *_Ctrl as "animctrl" on the SID tag node.

remove_render_tag.tip: Remove the render tag from the selected geo.
remove_render_tag.what: Renames _hi geos to _Geo and disconnects their render tag.
examples: Select the proxy geos that should not render and click it.
Untag proxy geos so they do not render.
remove_render_tag.details: Renames *_hi to *_Geo and disconnects every .message connection of the geo (the render tag link).

skull.tip: Show only the skull part of the face rig.
skull.what: Hides the other face parts and shows the skull geo, joints and ctrls so you can work on it alone.
steps: Click Wip (or another part) when done.
examples: Click it to paint or fix the skull without the rest of the face in the way.
Isolate skull to check its ctrls drive only that area.
skull.details: hide_face_componets() switches to WIP mode and hides Miscellaneous / Bind / Ctrl / BodySkull locals children, then show_this() shows that part rig groups, *_Bnd joints, its face head (BodyXxx) and its Local_Extra group.

add_extra_geos.tip: Add the extra geos to the face.
add_extra_geos.what: Makes the local system for the selected extra geos so they follow the face.
examples: Select eyelashes and eyebrows and click it.
Add eyelashes after the face install.
add_extra_geos.details: Deletes and rebuilds Local_Extra / Skull_Local_Extra: each extra geo gets a local copy that follows the face rig.

l_add_to_eyes_wires.tip: Add the selection to the left eyelid wires.
l_add_to_eyes_wires.what: Adds the selected geos to the left eyelid wire deformers so they blink with the lids.
examples: Select the left eyelashes and click it.
Add the left lashes to the lid wire.

r_add_to_eyes_wires.tip: Add the selection to the right eyelid wires.
r_add_to_eyes_wires.what: Adds the selected geos to the right eyelid wire deformers so they blink with the lids.

Add the right lashes to the lid wire.

auto_skin_lips.what: Skins the lips from the upper and lower edges set in the Lips block.
steps: Set the upper / lower lip edges in the Lips block.
examples: Set the lip edges in the block, build, click it.
Skin the lips of a new face quickly.
auto_skin_lips.details: auto_skin_helpers: reads Lips_Config.SetUpperEdge / SetLowerEdge (mesh.e[...]) and weights the lip loops to the lip joints.

auto_skin_eyes.what: Skins the eyelids from the edges set in the Eyelids block.
steps: Set the eyelid edges in the Eyelids block.
examples: Set the eyelid edges in the block, build, click it.
Skin the eyelids of a new face quickly.
auto_skin_eyes.details: auto_skin_helpers: reads L_Eyelids_Config.SetUpperEdge / SetLowerEdge and weights the lid loops to the eyelid joints.

upr_eyes_up.tip: Move the upper eyelid ctrl shapes up.
upr_eyes_up.what: Moves the shapes (not the ctrls) of the upper eyelid controllers up, so they sit outside the mesh.
examples: Click it a few times until the upper eyelid ctrls are easy to pick.
Click upr eyes up a few times on a character with a big face so the ctrls clear the mesh.
upr_eyes_up.details: Moves the CVs of the L side eyelid / lip ctrls 0.15 units (relative); the R side follows through the mirror. The ctrls themselves do not move, so no animation changes.

reload_jaw_tester.what: Opens the jaw 45 degrees and makes test shapes on the mouth geos to check the jaw skin.
examples: Click R, look at the mouth shapes, fix weights, click R again.
Compare jaw open shapes after painting.
reload_jaw_tester.details: Rotates Jaw_Ctrl.rx 45, duplicates BodyJaw as *_JawTester targets on the mouth heads (BodyMouthUp / Down / Wide / Narrow, BodyLips) so you compare them with the jaw open.

ribbonizer_ui_btn.what: Opens the Ribbonizer tool to make ribbon setups.
examples: Make a ribbon for a belt or a strap.
Make a ribbon for a scarf.

prop_get_clean_selection_button.what: Puts the selected objects or components in the field as clean text.
examples: Select vertices on the prop and click <<.
Fill the field with the vertices of a hinge.
prop_get_clean_selection_button.details: Flattened selection (components too) as comma separated text.

prop_aim_to_vtx_button.tip: Aim the selected object at the vertices.
prop_aim_to_vtx_button.what: Aims the selected objects at a cluster made from the components in the field.

Aim a camera prop at a point on a mesh.

Fill spaces with the hand ctrls.
prop_get_spaces_selection_button.details: Selected object names, comma separated, into the spaces field.

prop_spaces_on_sel_ctrl_button.tip: Add space switches to the selected ctrls.
prop_spaces_on_sel_ctrl_button.what: Gives the selected ctrls a space switch to every object in the spaces field.
steps: Fill the spaces field (<< or type names).
Switch spaces with the new enum attr.
examples: Let a sword ctrl follow world, the right hand or the left hand.
Let a cup ctrl switch between table and hand.
prop_spaces_on_sel_ctrl_button.details: Adds a space enum on each selected ctrl and constrains its offset group to every space, driven by the enum. Missing spaces are warned and skipped.

prop_match_pivots_btn.tip: Match pivots to the last selected.
prop_match_pivots_btn.what: Moves the pivot of every selected object to the pivot of the last one.
examples: Put the door pivot on the hinge object.
Put a lid pivot on the hinge.
prop_match_pivots_btn.details: xform -rotatePivot / -scalePivot of each selected object = the last selected pivot (world).

prop_skin_mode_on_btn.tip: Move joints without moving the skin.
prop_skin_mode_on_btn.what: Turns on Move Joints mode on every skinCluster: you can move joints and the meshes stay where they are.
examples: Turn it on, slide a pivot joint to the hinge, then turn it off.
Move joints of a skinned prop.
prop_skin_mode_on_btn.details: moveJointsMode 1 on every skinCluster in the scene.

prop_skin_mode_off_btn.what: Turns off Move Joints mode on every skinCluster, so joints deform the meshes again.
examples: Turn it off after moving the joints.
Turn off after moving the prop joints.
prop_skin_mode_off_btn.details: moveJointsMode 0 on every skinCluster in the scene.

reorder_sns.tip: Fix the squash and stretch deformer order.
reorder_sns.what: Reorders the deformers on the selected geo: squash, bend side, bend front, then skin.
examples: Click it when the head squash moves the skin the wrong way.
Fix the order after adding a new deformer to the head.
reorder_sns.details: reorderDeformers so the history reads: squash (bottom), bend side, bend front, skinCluster (top).

create_skirt_mirror_offsets.tip: Mirror the skirt guides while you move them.
create_skirt_mirror_offsets.what: Adds mirrored offset groups on the skirt guides (block prefix in the field) so moving one side moves the other.
examples: Click it, shape the left half of the skirt, the right half follows. Delete the offsets when done.
Shape a symmetric skirt fast.
create_skirt_mirror_offsets.details: skirt_helpers.create_mirror_skirt_groups(block_prefix): -1 scaled offset groups above the right skirt guides driven by the left ones.

delete_skirt_mirror_offsets.what: Deletes the mirror offset groups and puts the skirt guides back, keeping their new positions.
examples: Click it once the skirt guides are placed, before building.
Delete before building.
delete_skirt_mirror_offsets.details: skirt_helpers.delete_mirror_skirt_groups(block_prefix): bakes the guide positions and removes the groups.

create_skirt_rigmeshes.what: Makes skinned rig meshes for the skirt to copy weights from (uses the selected objects).
examples: Click it, then copy the weights from the rig mesh to the real skirt.
Make rig meshes to copy skirt weights.
create_skirt_rigmeshes.details: Makes cylinder rig meshes along the skirt chains (fixed vertex lists) skinned to them, to copy weights from.

create_skirt_vis_toggle.tip: Add the skirt IK / FK visibility toggle.
create_skirt_vis_toggle.what: Adds attrs that show or hide the skirt FK and IK ctrls, on the object in the attribute field.
examples: Put the toggle on the COG ctrl so animators can hide the skirt ctrls.
Add the toggle on the hip ctrl.
create_skirt_vis_toggle.details: skirt_helpers.add_skirt_vis_toggle(block_prefix, attribute_location): FK / IK vis attrs on that node.

fix_quad_foot.what: Re-aims the front and back foot guides of a quadruped.
examples: Click it after placing a quad's guides.
Fix feet orients on a dog rig.

feather_pivots_btn.what: Opens the Feather Pivots helper to edit the feather pivot attrs of a Wings block.
examples: Adjust where each feather rotates from.
Adjust feather pivots on a bird wing.

head.what: Binds each selected geo to the crowd skeleton joints of the head only.
steps: Check with a ROM, then paint.
examples: Select the hat and click it.
Rigid accessory on head: skin it here, then copy finer weights if needed.
head.details: skin_this_to_selected(joints): skinCluster -tsb on each selected geo with the crowd *_Skl joints of that part that exist (Hips / Spine / LeftArm... naming). A geo that already has a skinCluster errors.

copy_selected_skin.tip: Copy skin from first to second selected.
copy_selected_skin.what: Copies the weights from the first selected geo to the second, by closest point and closest joint.
examples: Select the old shirt, then the new shirt, click it.
Copy skin between two versions of a mesh.
copy_selected_skin.details: copySkinWeights -noMirror -surfaceAssociation closestComponent -influenceAssociation closestBone (both geos must be skinned).

copy_ns_skin.tip: Copy skin from a namespace to the scene.
copy_ns_skin.what: For each selected geo with a namespace, copies its skin to the geo with the same name without the namespace.
examples: Reference the old rig, select its geos, click it.
Copy skin from a referenced old rig.
copy_ns_skin.details: For each selected ns:geo, selects it and the same name without the namespace, then copySkinWeights.

reload_udims.what: Refreshes the viewport and reloads the UDIM textures.
examples: Click it when the textures show as tiles or black.
Reload UDIMs after texture updates.
reload_udims.details: Switches the viewport to Viewport 2.0 and regenerates the UDIM previews of the file textures.

label_joints.what: Sets side and type labels on all joints, so skin mirroring and copying by label work.
examples: Click it before mirroring skin weights.
Label before copying skin by label.
label_joints.details: Misc.label_joints.split_label_joints(): side from the L_ / R_ prefix and type "Other" with the name, on every joint.

proxy_maker.what: Opens Proxy Maker to make a fast cut-up proxy of the skinned character.
examples: Make a light rig version for blocking.
Make a light proxy for layout.

fari_deformersWeightsEditor.what: Opens a tool to edit and copy the weights of deformers (not skins).
examples: Paint the weights of a cluster or wire.
Paint cluster weights on a face.

switch_ikfk.tip: Switch the selected limb between IK and FK.
switch_ikfk.what: Matches IK to FK (or FK to IK) on the selected limb ctrl and flips the switch, without the pose jumping.
steps: Key it if you are animating.
examples: Select the wrist ctrl, click it to go from FK to IK at this frame.
Switch the leg to FK for a jump.
switch_ikfk.details: Animation.ikfk_match.ikfk_match_callback(): reads the limb switch attr, snaps the other mode ctrls to the current pose, then flips the switch.

dont_press.what: Makes the window almost see through. Close and open the tool to get it back.
examples: You were warned.
Do it on a colleague machine.
dont_press.details: setWindowOpacity(0.1) on the tool. Close and reopen to get it back.

reset_profile.what: Adds one to the team profile reset counter.
examples: Click it after resetting your Maya profile.
Count it after a broken prefs reset.
reset_profile.details: Studio only: bumps the counter in /job/anythinggoes/share/rigging/team/Esteban/reset_profile.json.

skin_to_other_button.tip: Copy skin from the first geo to the rest.
skin_to_other_button.what: Select the source geo first, then the targets: each target gets the source skin and weights.
examples: Select the body, then shirt, pants and shoes, click it.
Copy body skin to all clothes.
skin_to_other_button.details: Binds each target to the source skinCluster influences, then copySkinWeights source > target (closest point).

save_skin_joints.tip: Save the skin joints of the selection.
save_skin_joints.what: Saves the joints the selected geos are skinned to, to a temp file another Maya can read.
examples: Save in the old scene, then Select Saved Skin Joints in the new one.
Save the joints before a scene crash test.
save_skin_joints.details: Writes the influences of the selected geos, with their world positions, to a temp json.

load_skin_joints.what: Selects the joints saved with Save Skin Joints; missing joints can be made at their saved positions.
examples: In the new scene, click it, then shift select the geo and bind.
Select the joints to bind a new mesh.
load_skin_joints.details: Reads that temp json and selects the joints; missing ones can be created at the saved positions, parented to the world.

fix_legs_orients.tip: Fix the leg orients for mocap.
fix_legs_orients.what: Fixes the leg joint orients so mocap retargets cleanly.
examples: Click it before loading mocap.
Fix leg orients before a mocap retarget.

l_thumb_orient_plus.tip: Nudge the left thumb orient up.
l_thumb_orient_plus.what: Rotates the left thumb joint orients by the amount in the field (up), saving and loading back the skin so the mesh does not move.
steps: Click + or - until the thumb curls right.
examples: Click it until the thumb curls toward the palm, not across it.
Use small steps (2-5) and test with a fist pose after each l thumb orient plus.
l_thumb_orient_plus.details: mocap_helpers.nudge_thumb_orient(joints, amount): saves the skins of the geos using the thumb joints, removes them, rotates the joint orients, puts constraints back and loads the skins again.

examples: Click it until the thumb curls toward the palm, not across it.
Use small steps (2-5) and test with a fist pose after each l thumb orient minus.
l_thumb_orient_minus.details: mocap_helpers.nudge_thumb_orient(joints, amount): saves the skins of the geos using the thumb joints, removes them, rotates the joint orients, puts constraints back and loads the skins again.

arkkit_btn.what: Opens ArkKit to make the 52 ARKit face blendshapes from a face rig.
examples: Make the ARKit shapes for a face to use with live face capture.
Make ARKit shapes for a VTuber character.
